thread:
alex_m: rolled the canary at 16:03 and were seeing a jump in validator rejects for tool calls, console alerted. can anyone take a look?
sana: seeing ~520 rejects in the last 45m. majority are TYPE_MISMATCH on tool responses. example from logs: 
```
ERROR validation: fn=location_weather code=TYPE_MISMATCH path=tools.weather.temp_c -> expected number, got "21" (string)
```
jordan: graph shows spike scoped to canary routes but a handful on stable too. looks like fallback routing to older adapter is creating cross-variant schema issues.
rui: yep, routing policy falls back to v1-adapter when v2 capacity low. v1 often returns legacy compact shapes (strings for some numeric fields). strict validator on canary -> rejections. stable has lax validator and passes.
pat: current console alert only shows a single aggregate counter (invoke.validation.rejections). not very actionable. request: add metrics broken down by {route, model, tool, error_class}. e.g. tool_schema_reject_rate{route,model,tool,error_class}.
jordan: will add a grafana panel and a prom query for that. also propose we sample failing payloads (scrubbed) to a short-retention S3 bucket for QE. need to ensure no user prompt is stored.
sana: also asking for a soft-validate mode for canary slices: treat validator failures as warnings (metric only) but allow passthrough so user traffic isnt impacted while we fix adapters.
rui: we prototyped soft_validate flag on rollout slices. validator would emit invoke.validation.warning with a score and attach header x-validator-score to response. that should be enough to surface regressions.
pat: UX: rollout page should surface these warnings and let operators flip enforcement per-slice. add a small CTA: "Enforce schema (strict)" which shows top failure examples before applying.
alex_m: billing note: currently customers are billed tokens for requests that later fail validation. that causes confusion. short-term: flag these in billing reconciliation and surface counts in console. long-term: product to decide token-credit semantics. I created BILL-343.
ops-bot: incident.created id=INC-2033 scope=canary severity=low
jordan: proposed short-term checklist: 1) add dashboard panel for reject_count & warning_count by route/model/tool 2) implement scrubbed payload sampler to S3 (10k max, 24h retention) 3) expose soft_validate toggle per-slice in rollout config 4) alert: if stable.strict_reject_rate > 0.5% for 5m -> page oncall.
sana: can QE own the sampled payload inspection? Ill coordinate scrubbing rules (no prompts, stash only tool response and model headers).
rui: mitigation: will flip canary slice validators to lax for smallest slice (5%) until soft-validate and adapter fixes land. updating infra in ~15m.
pat: jordan can you add a query for the last 6h top 10 failure signatures per-tool and attach to the incident? that helps assign owners.
jordan: on it. ETA ~40m to push panel + attach link.
alex_m: assign follow-ups: jordan (dash + sampler), rui (slice -> lax), sana (sample rules + QE handoff), pat (rollout CTA copy + billing note). update thread after links are attached.
